title: nama stenophylla var. flavescens
intro: Nama stenophylla var. flavescens, commonly known as yellowstem plains beardtongue, is a flowering plant species in the borage family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory properties and ability to support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of yellowstem plains beardtongue may include antispasmodic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, helping to relieve respiratory issues and soothe skin irritations. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
